title: Step-by-Step Pronunciation Chunks
changes: Added an optional Build in chunks pronunciation mode before the complete-sentence attempt.
Let learners hear, record and review each short Japanese phrase independently.
Added a mobile-friendly progress track with completed chunks and an All together final step.
Used Sentence Lab's authored grammar chunks where available and safe phrase boundaries elsewhere.
Kept direct Whole sentence practice available at any time.
Fixed Pixel Chrome judging pronunciation before its final Japanese transcript arrived.
Kept live interim Japanese recognition and displayed detected words while the learner is speaking.
Waited for both audio recording and speech recognition to finish before showing pronunciation feedback.
Matched equivalent hiragana, katakana and common numeral transcriptions such as 二つ and 2つ.
Added clearer microphone-permission, live-listening and finishing-detection status messages.
Added distinct visual identities, colour themes and resident guides to all thirteen activities in the live Activity Skill Web.
Added persistent mastered states and illuminated skill-web branches backed by earned real-world can-do cards.
Added expressive completion scenes with stronger celebration art, resident guidance and a reduced-motion mode.
Created six consistent Sensei poses for welcoming, explaining, celebrating, encouraging, pointing and analysing feedback.
Added an optional Japanese pronunciation coach with private local recording, waveform playback and browser speech recognition.
Pronunciation feedback now reports which important phrases were heard and what to retry without inventing a percentage score.
Connected pronunciation coaching to Sentence Lab, Kaishi Theatre, Conversation Quest and Manga Stories.
Renamed visible Activity Village labels to Activity Skills so the interface accurately describes the current skill web.
Added Sentence Lab as a complete Activity Village and normal Journey destination.
Made the guided Sentence Lab available from the beginning while keeping later labs sequentially unlocked.
Created five guided real-world sentence missions with seven understanding stages in every lesson.
Added tappable colour-coded sentence breakdowns showing meaning, reading, grammatical role and word connections.
Added animated progressive sentence reveals that build meaning from the final action outward.
Added meaning-first phrase construction with support for multiple natural Japanese word orders.
Added particle replacement experiments with an exact explanation for every selected particle.
Added listen-predict-reveal challenges with phrase-by-phrase audio playback and active chunk highlighting.
Added tense, vocabulary and politeness transformations that preserve the rest of the sentence structure.
Added contextual subject inference to teach why familiar information is naturally omitted in Japanese.
Added transfer challenges that ask learners to produce new sentences from familiar patterns.
Added a shared Sentence Notebook for mining, hearing, translating and revisiting useful Japanese.
Connected Sentence Notebook mining controls to Manga Stories, Conversation Quest and Kaishi Theatre dialogue.
Added persistent mistake review with targeted explanations and one-tap pattern practice.
Connected Sentence Lab answers to sentence and listening mastery, streak activity, cloud progress and daily recommendations.
Added a mobile-optimised illustrated Sentence Lab workshop and lightweight learning animations.
Added a five-position preference slider from mostly listening to mostly reading.
Added Let Sensei decide mode, which compares reading and listening performance and reinforces the weaker skill.
Applied the preference to vocabulary question selection, mastery priorities and daily activity recommendations.
Kept both reading and listening in every learning path with a protective minimum share for the non-preferred skill.
Fixed Listening Station immediately reporting Game complete for a fresh admin test learner.
Restored a safe default activity session length for isolated profiles with no saved settings.
Allowed Picture Meadow, Listening Station, Karuta Arena and Memory Dojo to build test rounds from unlocked test content without requiring fake completion progress.
Added Lunch at the Convenience Store, a Level 1 three-page interactive manga for checkout practice.
Added The Day the Train Stopped, a Level 3 three-page interactive manga for navigating travel disruption.
Created six matching monochrome manga pages with mobile-friendly dialogue space.
Included tappable vocabulary, English translations, guided panel audio and active-word highlighting throughout both stories.
Changed manga page progression to a left-to-right swipe gesture with matching navigation arrows.
Added a speaker control to the bottom-right of every comic panel.
Panel playback now reads Japanese word by word and highlights the active word.
Displayed The Lost Wallet's Level 2 difficulty and two-of-four rating consistently with other manga stories.
Added The Lost Wallet, a three-page right-to-left interactive manga story.
Placed Japanese dialogue inside comic-panel speech balloons with tap-to-hear words.
Added an English dialogue toggle, mobile page swiping, manga-direction controls and keyboard navigation.
Added four stable speech poses for both Aiko and Kai: closed, small, rounded and wide mouths.
Locked every frame to the same portrait, pose, crop and background to prevent animation wobble.
Replaced binary open-and-close swapping with a smoother phoneme-style speaking cycle.
Replaced the synthetic mouth overlay with matched full character animation frames.
Added dedicated resting and speaking portraits for both Kai and Aiko.
Added three genuine café camera angles: establishing, close counter and reverse seating views.
Cut between speaker-focused shots throughout the dialogue with responsive character framing.
Added asset preloading so camera and mouth-frame changes remain smooth during playback.
Added a complete Ordering at a Café episode built around real-world Japanese practice.
Introduced Theatre's five-act learning flow: Watch, Understand, Explore, Join and Perform.
Added three interactive customer role-play decisions with natural phrase feedback.
Added private in-browser voice recording, model playback and self-assessment for shadowing practice.
Added speech-synchronised mouth movement, expressive gestures, voice waves, camera drift and prop animation.
Created a dedicated character-free anime café stage optimised for desktop and mobile layouts.
Added 50 new illustrated vocabulary mnemonics for previously uncovered words.
Matched the established colourful anime scene style and recurring learner characters.
Added concise visual captions, sound hooks and accessible alternative text for every new scene.
Expanded approved mnemonic coverage from 646 to 696 vocabulary entries.
Fixed the lesson getting stuck after an Adaptive Micro-Practice / Listening Station intervention.
Micro-Practice now opens as an overlay and never replaces the underlying lesson card DOM, preserving all native event handlers and progression state.
Continue Lesson simply closes the intervention and returns to the already-rendered normal learning card.
Matched Japanese Journey and Japan Ready carousel card heights dynamically so swiping no longer jumps between different card heights.
Added safe top spacing inside study-mode carousel cards so active headings and icons are never clipped.
Inactive neighbouring cards now show only a subtle visual edge; their heading/icon is hidden until that card becomes active, avoiding chopped airplane/book icons.
Retains desktop side-by-side cards with both headings fully visible.
Retains all v11.8.0 Adaptive Micro-Practice scoring/cooldown behavior and v11.7.x learning-summary/touch/performance improvements.
Added a clear Journey and Japan Ready selector with full-width mobile campaign cards.
Made the mobile dashboard more compact and added persistent bottom navigation.
Improved touch target sizes, focus visibility and dashboard visual hierarchy.
Added an admin-only fully unlocked test learner for end-to-end feature testing.
Stored all test answers, settings and resumable missions separately from personal learning progress.
Paused cloud progress sync, snapshots and flushes while the test learner is active.
Added a persistent test-mode banner with one-tap return to the real profile.
Restored the Japanese Journey single-card design with a coloured outer surround.
Restyled Japan Ready to match Journey's unified card hierarchy and dimensions.
Added accessible pagination dots beneath the mobile cards with the active page filled.
Kept the labelled Journey and Japan Ready selector for direct navigation.
Added party lunge, strike impact, monster counterattack, knockback and revival animations to Kotoba Colosseum.
Added clear critical-hit, hit and revive effects while respecting reduced-motion preferences.
Rebuilt Activity Landmarks as an original connected RPG skill web with unlock paths, progress rings and branching nodes.
Optimised the skill web for compact mobile screens and keyboard/touch navigation.
Integrated Kotoba Colosseum as the final combat node connected directly after Memory Dojo.
Made the Colosseum node show battle-word readiness and launch the activity directly from the tree.
Removed the redundant detached Colosseum landmark beneath the skill web.
Bumped release-controlled assets and service-worker caches to v11.8.17.
